correctness.rationale: For each integer m>=3, the six explicit homogeneous degree-(2m-1) forms have no common zero; hence their P2 map is finite because O(2m-1) is ample. The image divisor of c=0 has one lifting divisor, with rational image parameter T=-u6/u5 restricting to b/a; outside c=0, the simultaneous conditions u3=u4=0 force T^m=1, excluding the generic image divisor. In the source function field, the image functions G=u3/u1 and H=1+(2m-1)(u1/u5)T^(m-1) have c-adic orders m-1 and m; the latter follows from the exact numerator derivative (m-1)t^(m(m-1))(1+t^(-m)). Consequently the sole valuation extension has ramification index 1 and residue degree 1. The characteristic-zero defect-free DVR fundamental equality yields field degree 1. The finite birational map from normal P2 normalizes its image. Pullback O(1)=O(2m-1), giving image degree (2m-1)^2, while the rational image of c=0 has degree 2m-1. All transverse first derivatives vanish along generic c=0 when m>=3, whereas the tangent derivative of T is nonzero, so the surface is nonnormal generically along that divisor. Independent exact-arithmetic checkers `verify_valuation.py` and `verify_finite_images.py` completed successfully; no finite sample is used to prove the uniform theorem.
